integrity: An analytical proof covers all path lengths and positive transmission probabilities; an independently implemented event-by-event exhaustive checker tests cases through seven vertices, not an infinite certificate. Literature comparison is not a claim of exhaustive priority.
scientific_limitations: One initially infected uniformly random individual, one independent Bernoulli transmission opportunity per path edge, distinct contact times and no recovery. For fixed probability q<1 the upper bound remains bounded. The original index-case offspring mean is not an infinite-population reproduction threshold. Historical priority for equivalent temporal-path mean formulas is not certified.
title: Sharp mean outbreak bounds for one-shot temporal paths
